gotas-ecocity-idu-gousa.overview: Planned around green spaces, Gotas Ecocity brings the quieter pace of suburban life within reach of the city. Paved roads, recreational parks and shared infrastructure make up the estate in Idu Gousa, where Gotas began with its first 91 serviced plots.
gotas-ecocity-idu-gousa.subtitle: A garden community with room to grow.

kingsland-idu-gousa.overview: Kingsland pairs high-end finishes with smart-home integration. The gated estate in Idu Gousa is planned for residents who value privacy, shared leisure spaces and ample parking. A clubhouse and pool form part of its published amenities.
kingsland-idu-gousa.subtitle: Connected homes in a gated community.

kings-garden-estate-kabusa.overview: Kings Garden Estate combines landscaped green areas with road access and a perimeter fence in Kabusa. Its peaceful setting and essential services are intended for growing families and professionals who want a quieter home within the city.
kings-garden-estate-kabusa.subtitle: Green space and a quieter pace in Kabusa.

the-aurora-by-gotas.overview: Also known as Gotas Pearl Residences, The Aurora is planned as an eco-themed estate in Sauka, Kuje. It neighbours Double Kings and Fhemfels estates. The development aims to combine smart-home features, nature and accessible payment plans upon completion.
